title: The server speaks to a running playback
description: Serves "What can't be done is said plainly."; "Failures are invisible."; "The picture follows the connection.". D-148: server-sent and one-way.
acceptanceCriteria: The server can tell a running playback to step down, that a track is ready, where to resume after a failure, and why something failed.

Messages are sent by the server only; an app that loses its connection gets every message it missed when it reconnects, and an app returning to the foreground catches up without asking for the playback again.
Octave's Android TV app, or the native browser check until it exists, acts on each.
Every capability it adds is in the published contract (JS-183) and passes its conformance check.
